mime_type.description: The Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type of the item's data. For example: text/plain.
mime_type.caption: MIME type

binary_data.description: The item's data in binary form, used when the clipboard content cannot be represented as text or when preserving the exact binary representation is required.
binary_data.caption: Binary Data

clipboard_native_type.description: The type of the item's data, in an operating specific form. For example: CF_TEXT or public.utf8-plain-text.
clipboard_native_type.caption: Data Type

string_data.description: The item's data if it can be represented as a UTF-8 string.
string_data.caption: String Data

name: clipboard_item
description: A piece of data on the system clipboard.
caption: Clipboard Item
